content: इज्य {%<ab>pot. p.</ab>%} (of यज्) To be worshipped. .{@-ज्यः@} .²1 A teacher; हंसा य एकं बहुरूपमिज्यैर्मायामयं वेद स वेद वेदम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 12. 23</ls>. .²2 An epithet of वृहस्पति, the teacher of the gods. .²3 The Puṣya Nakṣatra. .²4 The Supreme Being; खधीः कलत्रादिषु भौम इज्यधीः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 84. 13</ls>. .²5 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .{@-ज्या@} .²1 A sacrifice; जगत्प्रकाशं तदशेषमिज्यया <ls>R. 3. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 68</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 2</ls>; <ls>Bg. 11. 53</ls>, भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्याः <ls n="Bg.">9. 25</ls>. .²2 A gift, donation. .²3 An image. .²4 Worship, reverence. .²5 Meeting, union. .²6 A bawd or procuress. .²7 A cow.
